checks.evidence: One action, worded three ways: 'Book a free review' (nav, pricing.html), 'Start with a free month-end review' (index.html hero), 'Book your free month-end review' (contact.html H1). Present but wording varies: partial.
Form at /contact, linked from the nav and the index.html hero.
contact.html: 10 fields, 7 required, including revenue and phone.
pricing.html: '$349/month', 'From $299/location/month' with no currency for a Canada and US business (about.html); catch-up 'Quoted per month of backlog' with no range.
No proof on pricing.html or contact.html; no privacy link or notice on contact.html.
No viewport meta tag on index, pricing, about or contact.

findings.finding: The contact form asks for 10 fields, 7 required, including annual revenue and phone.
findings.evidence: contact.html: required first_name, last_name, email, phone, restaurant, locations, revenue.
findings.fix: Keep first name, email, restaurant and locations; ask revenue and phone on the review call.

findings.finding: No proof or privacy notice at the decision point.
findings.evidence: contact.html and pricing.html carry no testimonial; contact.html has no privacy link.
findings.fix: Privacy line with a policy link under the button; the Okafor quote beside the form once she confirms naming permission.

findings.finding: Prices have no currency and catch-up has no range.
findings.fix: Add CAD or USD to each price and a 'from' price per month of backlog.

findings.finding: The primary action is worded three ways.
findings.evidence: 'Book a free review', 'Start with a free month-end review', 'Book your free month-end review'.
findings.fix: Use 'Book a free month-end review' everywhere.

findings.evidence: No <meta name="viewport"> on any of the four pages.
findings.fix: Add the viewport tag to every page's head.

strengths: One click from the nav or the hero reaches the form.
The testimonial is specific and attributed.
not_observable: Form starts, submits and conversion rate (no analytics export).
